hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a buy-pressure engine per pool: it absorbs main-token sells using a configurable secondary-token pot (SHIELD, via beforeSwap delta), and on buys executes a secondary-to-main swap from the pot (PUMP, via afterSwap self-swap). Also auto-harvests LP fees from configured programs and compounds them into the pot.
